description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Fire with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Samurai Mode I (Auron)] and [Samurai Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Samurai Mode I (Auron)
description.text: Samurai abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Samurai abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x2.00/x2.50/x3.00 for equipped Samurai abilities after casting 1/2/3 Samurai abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Samurai Mode II (Auron)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Samurai Mode II (Auron)
description.text: Samurai abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, instant cast speed for Samurai abilities, grants [Dualcast Samurai 1] and [Samurai +30% Boost 1] to all allies after using Samurai abilities, grants [100% Critical 1] and [Critical Damage +50% 1] to the user after using Samurai abilities

description.name: Critical Damage +50% 1
description.text: Critical hits deal 50% more damage (additive with the base critical coefficient)

description.name: Attach Fire with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3
